Rede's seventh beta makes installing an update yourself clearer. Betas 4 to 6 were test releases and have been removed; if you have 0.1.0-beta.3, Settings › About offers this one.

Keep your Audiobookshelf backups: Rede writes listening progress, finished status and bookmarks to your server. Please report problems with your OS, Rede and server versions, and steps to reproduce.

### Downloads

| File | For |
| --- | --- |
| `Rede-0.1.0-beta.7-macos-universal.dmg` (or `.zip`) | macOS 11 or later, Apple silicon and Intel |
| `Rede-0.1.0-beta.7-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` | Linux on Intel/AMD, glibc 2.39 or newer |
| `Rede-0.1.0-beta.7-linux-aarch64.tar.gz` | Linux on ARM64, glibc 2.39 or newer |

The `.minisig` files are signatures Rede checks before installing an update. [Install and sign-in instructions](https://github.com/Solidsilver/ond/blob/rede-v0.1.0-beta.7/docs/rede/README.md).

### What's new

- When a newer version is out, Settings › About offers **Install**, which downloads and checks it inside Rede, and **Get from GitHub**, which opens its release page. Before, the button opened GitHub even when Rede could install the update itself. After Install, Restart to Update installs it; quitting installs it too.
- A copy that can't install itself, such as one run from the dmg, offers only Get from GitHub and says why.
- Install updates automatically and the Channel row work as in [0.1.0-beta.3](https://github.com/Solidsilver/ond/releases/tag/rede-v0.1.0-beta.3).

### Please report

If an update doesn't install, Settings › About says why. Please report it with your OS, how you installed Rede, and that message.

The beta limits are the same as 0.1.0-beta.3's.
